payload.note: Actual-Gibbs annealed edge ellipticity: at lambda=2/5 every directed ratio has E[w_xy^2]<=8088/25, every log jump has E[exp(2|d_xy|)]<=16176/25, and every canonical edge current has E|J_xy|<=8932/25, uniformly in volume. Thus individual extreme edge jumps have exponential tails and their expected density is exponentially small in the jump threshold. The remaining escape is coherent accumulation of moderate jumps along long paths/blocks; no background-marginal hyperuniformity or interacting H^-1 promotion is made.
